primary_metric_definition: VALIDATE AUC of a point-in-time score for 'wallet has >= 1 fill in (market, 30-s bin)' over every CS2 moneyline/child_moneyline market, bins gs..gs+4h, no own-state features (pre-registered in NOTES.md).

live_lab.what: own recorder v1, feed tommy_cs2_books (code/iter2/cs2_recorder.py, first version): unthrottled CLOB market-channel messages of every CS2 match/map-winner market in play, via live.Writer; stopped after 13 min (21 MB/h, too much disk)

own recorder v2, feed tommy_cs2_near (code/iter2/cs2_recorder.py): same markets; price changes within 5c of the best bid/ask, near-touch snapshots every 30 s or when the best moves >= 2c, all last trades; filed dev/sealed by block via live.Writer; detached process, hard stop 2026-11-03 00:00 UTC, 280 MB cap

strategy_statement: CS2 in-play bot (maker regime from 10-16; before that a round-trip taker in GRID tier-1/2 events). [VALIDATE-only] Selection: whole events (match + all maps) of non-GRID tier-3 leagues (1win, Stake, PGL, Circuit X, DraculaN, NODWIN, ...; since 10-31 also CyberClash and FiReSPORTS), never an event with a GRID official-data series id (0/122), favouring events with high pre-game popularity; event-level rule AUC 0.954 vs activity baseline 0.892 (gain +0.062, p 0.002), recall 0.72 at lift 3.3. [VALIDATE-only] Maker: from game start it keeps 100-share BUY orders on whole cents on BOTH outcome tokens, joining the best bid (43% of filled orders exactly at the bid in live books; 24% at a touch rebuilt from all makers' filled orders), never sells, merges complete pairs (97% of shares paired, pair cost 0.978) and holds the residual; it does not pull its bids when other makers do, so the pack fills them. [VALIDATE-only live, small sample; hypothesis as a frozen rule] Taker trigger: about 0.3-1.0 s after other makers cancel the near-touch asks of one team without any trade (depth collapse; precedes 87% of its taker orders, random times 3%), it sends a FAK BUY of that team at the best ask + 0-2c (median fill 12%), acting on 5-8% of such collapses (the deeper ones that leave a stale best ask); the informed pack (0x4ebc2722 and a 3-wallet operator) does the same 0.3-0.5 s later; the bought team then gains +2.6-2.9c in 10 s and +4-5c in 60 s, with adverse >= 4c moves in 20-23% (in-round information, not known round results). [hypothesis] The cancelling makers have a faster game feed than the stream-priced makers; the wallet either reads their cancels from the public book or shares a similar feed slightly later. [VALIDATE-only] Economics: locked pair margins plus the informed taker legs; a generic public-data ladder in the same markets loses 5-10% and its per-market PnL correlates negatively with the wallet's.

selection.description: Events (all markets) of non-GRID tier-3 leagues; GRID events never (0/122); event-level logistic (league rate with GRID zeroing + pre-game popularity) AUC 0.954 vs 0.892 baseline, recall 0.72 at lift 3.3 on VALIDATE.

timing.description: Maker: continuous from game start (VALIDATE-only). Taker: 0.3-1.0 s (median 0.77) after a public depth collapse on one side of the book (other makers cancel, no trade); live-BUILD only (one dev block, 40 orders): S_col AUC 0.846 vs market-grouped CV prints baseline 0.512; live VALIDATE from 11-01 18:00 UTC.

side.description: Maker: both outcomes. Taker: the team whose asks collapsed (100% of matched orders on the collapse side); that team gains in 72-77% of cases within 60 s.

price.description: Maker: join the best bid on whole cents (43% exact in live books, 24% vs rebuilt touch, 11.5% vs last print); deeper ladder levels are censored. Taker: FAK at best ask (52%) or ask + 1-2c (29%).

size.description: Maker 100 shares (88% VALIDATE, 78% live); taker sizes variable (1000/2000 caps early, odd later), not decoded.

exit.description: Never sells; merges complete pairs; holds the unpaired residual to resolution.

A1.evidence: CS2 match/map markets resolve on the match result (Gamma resolutionSource https://hltv.org); no price-feed settlement.

A2.evidence: No crypto underlying: all 229 maker-regime markets are CS2 (220) or Dota 2 (9) match/map winners.

A4.evidence: Sibling markets (match vs maps) before its taker orders: share with a >= 2c sibling move in the prior 5 s 3.2% vs 2.3% at random times; prior 10 s 5.6% vs 3.7%: no cross-market lead (results/taker_trigger.json).

A4b.evidence: Kalshi public API: 1,200 open events scanned, no CS2 or esports event; sportsbooks need keys (brief); bo3.gg bet_updates is a static Thunderpick pre-match line (info panel). No other venue prices these tier-3 CS2 maps in play.

A5.evidence: Sports websocket has round scores only for GRID events (info panel); the wallet's events are non-GRID, so it cannot time their rounds. bo3.gg: no live coverage for the wallet's live matches today (live_coverage None); bo3 round durations do not align pack clusters better than permuted durations (round_align.json). HLTV blocked (403). Kick VOD stream clock = X4 (open).

A7.evidence: Recorded books (clob_wallets, dev block 10-31 12-18): a near-touch depth collapse by other makers' cancels precedes 87% of its taker orders (random 3%); live taker presence AUC 0.943 vs 0.529; maker orders join the best bid 43% (dev_books.json, collapse_*.json). prices-history unused.

A8.evidence: No market-wide outage explains its activity dips: on 10-18 (375 trades) CS2 markets printed 2-4.6k taker trades per hour 11-19 UTC; minute gaps in the tapes follow the schedule. The dip matches the number of whitelisted events (6 on 10-18 vs 11-35 other days). The 10-29 pause is in a sealed lot.

B1.evidence: 29,936 wallet txs decoded (25,878 orders: signing ms, full size, limit price) + 79,234 public taker txs of its markets (results/describe_orders.json, timing_xcorr.json).

B2.evidence: Filled orders: lifetimes median 15.8 s; live books: filled maker orders at the bid 43%; cancellations of OTHER makers are the taker trigger (A7). Its own cancels: lost depth before its taker orders is not in 100-share units (11%), so it does not pull; own ladder depth not yet measured.

B3.evidence: Touch rebuilt from every maker's filled orders: price = best known resting bid 24% (within 1c 40%); last print 11.5%; own last fill (match clock) 18.7%; live: join the bid 43% (price_touch.json, dev_books.json). Fair-value models not needed for the maker: it joins the touch.

B4.evidence: BUY-only; 2,129 MERGE rows; 97.4% of bought shares paired; pair cost 0.9785 (results/inventory.json).

B5.evidence: 67% of its maker fills on the short-inventory side; taker side independent of inventory (49/50); residual unpaired median 29% of max |net| (results/size_taker.json, inventory.json).

B6.evidence: Maker rebates $2.05k (17-22 Oct) and taker rebates $2.2k vs settlement PnL $13.1k on 16-22 Oct: material but not the main source.

B7.evidence: REWARD rows total $1 on 15-22 Oct although 85% of its orders are 100 shares within 4.5c: rewards are not a driver.

B9.evidence: MAKER_REBATE rows are daily without market ids (10-16..10-21: $50, $309, $27, $431, $423, $812), a stable 0.26-0.27% of its daily traded USD: no per-market rebate-pool selection is visible; the rebate scales with volume.

C1.evidence: Owners via eth_call owner(): wallet 0x8af810f0..., P4e 0xbf6461fa..., P8a 0x875909d7... (different EOAs); co-maker 0xe8e1b119 has a different signature type. Funding graph not done.

C2.evidence: Pack signs after the wallet (+0.48 s cluster; P4e -51 ms); following the pack's prints loses out of sample (iter 1). Today the pack also follows the book collapse, about 0.3 s after the wallet: a common trigger, not copying.

C3.evidence: 3,111 distinct counterparties, top-10 share 19%: no single predictable victim (results/describe_orders.json).

C4.evidence: Whole history 06-16..10-22: regime switch on 10-16 from GRID tier-1/2 round-trip taking (99% of USD in GRID events, 46% sells) to non-GRID tier-3 buy-only making + FAK taking (0% GRID, 0 sells); within the maker regime size versions (iter 1). taker_regime.json.

C4b.evidence: No market-parameter change (iter 1). The switch coincides with a change of universe to non-GRID events where the pack already operated since at least 09-26 (P4e in 48% of those events before 10-16). No Polymarket announcement found.

C5.evidence: Selection is by league, not hour: inside 09-19 UTC CCT Europe 0/52 and ESEA 0/37 while 1win Private Club 10/10 (results/selection.json); all activity 08-23 UTC following its league schedules; taker submissions automated (sign-to-block 2.4-4.5 s, uniform ms).

C6.evidence: All 29,936 wallet transactions are V2 matchOrders (no RFQ/combo calls); rfqEnabled False on its markets.

C7.evidence: Self-matching: 0 of 1,698 taker transactions (16-22 Oct) include it as a maker; owners of the wallet and P4e differ. Referral income not checked.

C8.evidence: Fingerprint: sigType 3 deposit wallet, builder = metadata = 0, salt ~ Math.random()*Date.now(), 100-share whole-cent maker orders, FAK takers at ask + 0-2c. One web search found only generic or sports two-sided makers (spfunctions/polymarket-sports-mm, LeapTech-Lab/poly-maker, warproxxx/poly-maker), none with CS2 logic or cancel-following.

D1.evidence: Unit = the order (B1): orders.parquet with signing times.

D2.evidence: Event-level logistic selection; live 0.5-s hazard-style taker presence on book state (collapse score).

D3.evidence: Generic two-sided ladder replay on the public tape (strict fills): loses 5-10%, per-market PnL corr with the wallet -0.06..-0.12 (pnl_replay.json).

D4.evidence: Settlement PnL $13.1k = maker fills about +$4.0k (+0.47%) + taker fills about +$9.1k (+5.98%); locked pairs $21.6k, unpaired residual -$8.4k (results/inventory.json).

X1.evidence: Reviewer (C4b): no fee / rewards / delay change on CS2 markets 10-01..10-22; the switch is a change of universe GRID -> non-GRID (taker_regime.json).

X2.evidence: Reviewer: round-boundary Markov quoting. Boundary-only requoting rejected (iter 1); maker price = join the bid (live); Markov valuation of the taker filter untested.

X3.evidence: Reviewer: sports websocket CS2 map scores. For the wallet's (non-GRID) events the socket carries map scores only (info panel, 10-31 dev block); it cannot be the trigger source; where it has rounds (GRID) the market leads it by a median 23 s.

X4.evidence: info panel P1 (iter 1): Kick VOD stream clock (PDT + ffmpeg HUD diffs). Not run: needs downloading VOD video segments (~70 MB per map); the panel itself asked to confirm with the user first. Playlist PDT metadata alone was not fetched yet.

X5.evidence: info panel P2: GRID id boundary. 0/122 GRID events traded; event-level frozen rule AUC 0.954 vs 0.892, gain +0.062 [0.019, 0.115], p 0.002, recall 0.72 at lift 3.3 (final_rule.py, selection_event.json). PIT (grid_pit.py, 14:20-15:14 UTC): the gridSeriesId key is attached 1.0-1.3 h before the start (CCT Europe and Gamers Club Masters got GRID ids, FiReSPORTS a null), never later in the checks. Own-recorder data: deep trade-free collapses 23.7% of collapses in non-GRID vs 5.4% in GRID events (grid_collapse.json).

X6.evidence: info panel P3: coverage fingerprint. Stream-channel prior +0.005 VALIDATE AUC (0.962 vs 0.957), platform +0.004 (not adopted); hltv.org-only events (no stream) never traded (0/12); bo3 live_coverage None for its live matches. A provider-level coverage list not found.

X7.evidence: info panel P4: own recorder for all CS2 markets started (tommy_cs2_books, then tommy_cs2_near); book-event trigger measured on the shared recorder: depth collapse precedes 87% of its taker orders vs 3% random (collapse_trigger.json).

X8.evidence: info panel P5: bo3 per-round team stats as labels; needs a round clock (bo3 durations do not align, round_align.json).

X9.evidence: info panel P6: 10-16 switch vs GRID: it left GRID events entirely on 10-16; the pack was already in its new leagues (taker_regime.json, pre-switch tapes).

X10.evidence: mechanics panel P1: pack clusters 1.31 per bo3 round (P4e 0.66, wallet 0.26); timing-only DP alignment to bo3 rounds = permuted control (5.0 vs 4.7 tight links/map): not round ends at bo3 resolution. Live part (b): the socket has no round scores for its events; the pack's live trigger is the same book collapse (46.5% drop before vs 2.9%).

X11.evidence: mechanics panel P2: child orders on the match clock. Own-fill anchor (match clock) 18.7% exact; rebuilt touch 24%; live join-bid 43%. Re-sign split (resign_split.py): filled maker signings in [+0.5, +2) s after public taker signings 3.7-4.1x control when the taker matched the wallet, 2.8-3.2x when it matched only others: both user and market channels.

X12.evidence: mechanics panel P3: pair unit = taker order + complement maker orders signed 0.5-5 s later (477 of 1,631 parents; pair cost median 0.95): unit PnL BUILD +$3.3k (p 0.27), VALIDATE +$5.1k (p 0.14) vs parent leg +$5.2k (p 0.15) / +$3.9k (p 0.22): not significant per split (pair_unit.json).

X13.evidence: mechanics panel P4: live books (40 orders): taker size / depth up to its limit at signing median 1.22 (IQR 0.91-4.29), never equal; fill / that depth median 0.95: size is a cap above the stale depth left, which it takes almost fully (taker_size_depth.json). Stale-depth league score not built.

X14.evidence: mechanics panel P5: owner recovery via owner(): wallet 0x8af810f0, P4e 0xbf6461fa, P8a 0x875909d7 (different); 3-wallet POLY_PROXY cluster owners not readable; funding graph and complementary sizing not done.

X15.evidence: assumptions panel P1: P4e present in 39-48% of whitelisted non-GRID events, 0% of other non-GRID and of GRID events (before and after the switch); the sports socket has no round scores for its events; listing-level coverage proxies (stream channel, platform) add at most +0.005 AUC; hltv.org-only events never traded (0/12). The feed behind the cancels is not identified.

X16.evidence: assumptions panel P2: taker regime fetched (72,639 activity rows 06-16..10-16) and 11,692 transactions of 10-01..10-15 decoded: all taker FAK orders, 58% BUY / 42% SELL, 99.5% in-play, fill fraction median 100% (vs 12% after the switch), GRID tier-1/2 universe (taker_regime.json, taker_regime_orders.json). Sign-to-block (real block times, 40 sampled txs) median 34 s, p95 291 s, min 2.1 s although secondsDelay = 1: pre-signed orders fired later, so the taker-regime signing time is not the decision time (maker regime: 2.4-4.5 s).

X17.evidence: assumptions panel P3: executable tape replays vs the wallet per market (BUILD / VALIDATE Pearson): strict-fill ladder -0.06 / -0.12, follow-pack -0.14 / -0.11, both -0.14 / -0.17, at-touch ladder -0.40 / +0.11 (pnl_replay.json, pnl_follow_pack.json): no positive rule; the per-market PnL is driven by the residual from its stale bids being hit by the pack.

X18.evidence: assumptions panel P4: h1/h2 have no books or game feed (recordings start 10-31): the taker trigger can only be examined on future blocks (own recorder running); h1/h2 claims limited to selection, size, price vs last print, exit. Sports-api REST history probe not done.
